title: Can Thought Field Therapy (TFT) be Helpful for Patients With an Anxiety Disorder?
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to find out if Thought Field Therapy has effect on certain anxiety disorders; agoraphobia, social phobia, and post traumatic stress disorder (PTSD).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* One or more of the study diagnoses agoraphobia, social phobia and/or PTSD

Exclusion Criteria:

* Ongoing psychosis
* Ongoing serious drug problems
